sn12.51:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn12.51:2.1: kittāvatā nu kho bhikkhave bhikkhū parivīmaṃsamāno parivīmaṃseyya sabbaso sammā dukkhakkhayāyāti?
sn12.51:2.2: “bhagavaṃ mūlakā no bhante, dhammā. bhagavaṃ nettikā, bhagavaṃ paṭisaraṇā. sādhu vata bhante bhagavantaṃ eva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī”ti.
sn12.51:2.3: tena hi bhikkhave, suṇātha. sādhukaṃ manasi karotha. bhāsissāmīti.
sn12.51:2.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
sn12.51:3.2: “yaṃ kho idaṃ anekavidhaṃ. nānappakārakaṃ dukkhaṃ loke uppajjati jarāmaraṇaṃ.
sn12.51:3.3: idaṃ nu kho dukkhaṃ kinnidānaṃ, kiṃsamudayaṃ, kiṃjātikaṃ, kiṃpabhavaṃ.
sn12.51:3.4: kismiṃ sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti. kismiṃ asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hotī”ti.
sn12.51:3.6: “yaṃ kho idaṃ anekavidhaṃ nānappakārakaṃ dukkhaṃ loke uppajjati jarāmaraṇaṃ, idaṃ kho dukkhaṃ jātinidānaṃ jātisamudayaṃ jātijātikaṃ jātippabhavaṃ.
sn12.51:3.7: jātiyā sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti. jātiyā asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hotī”ti.
sn12.51:4.1: so jarāmaraṇañca pajānāti. jarāmaraṇasamudayañca pajānāti. jarāmaraṇanirodhañca pajānāti. yā ca jarāmaraṇanirodhasāruppagāminī paṭipadā taṃ ca pajānāti. tathā paṭipanno ca hoti anudhammacārī.
sn12.51:4.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabbaso sammā dukkhakkhayāya paṭipanno hoti jarāmaraṇanirodhāya.
sn12.51:5.2: “jātipanāyaṃ kinnidānā, kiṃsamudayā, kiṃjātikā, kiṃpabhavā, kismiṃ sati jāti hoti, kismiṃ asati jāti na hotī”ti.
sn12.51:5.5: bhave sati jāti hoti. bhave asati jāti na hotī”ti.
sn12.51:6.1: so jātiṃ ca pajānāti. jātisamudayaṃ ca pajānāti. jātinirodhaṃ ca pajānāti. yā ca jātinirodhasāruppagāminī paṭipadā, taṃ ca pajānāti. tathā paṭipanno ca hoti anudhammacārī.
sn12.51:6.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabbaso dukkhakkhayāya paṭipanno hoti jātinirodhāya.
sn12.51:7.2: “bhavo panāyaṃ kinnidāno, kiṃsamudayo, kiñjātiko, kimpabhavo, kismiṃ sati bhavo hoti, kismiṃ asati bhavo na hotī”ti. so parivīmaṃsamāno evaṃ pajānāti: bhavo upādānanidāno. upādānasamudayo, upādānajātiko, upādānapabhavo. upādāne sati bhavo hoti. upādāne asati bhavo na hotīti. so bhavaṃ ca pajānāti. bhavasamudayaṃ ca pajānāti. bhavanirodhaṃ ca pajānāti. yā ca bhavanirodhasāruppagāminī paṭipadā, taṃ ca pajānāti. tathā paṭipanno ca hoti anudhammacārī. ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabbaso dukkhakkhayāya paṭipanno hoti bhavanirodhāya. athāparaṃ parivīmaṃsamāno parivīmaṃsati:
sn12.51:7.10: saṅkhārā panime kinnidānā, kiṃsamudayā, kiñjātikā, kimpabhavā,
sn12.51:7.11: kismiṃ sati saṅkhārā honti, kismiṃ asati saṅkhārā na hontī”ti.
sn12.51:7.14: avijjāya sati saṅkhārā honti. avijjāya asati saṅkhārā na hontīti.
sn12.51:8.1: so saṅkhāre ca pajānāti. saṅkhārasamudayaṃca pajānāti. saṅkhāra nirodhaṃ ca pajānāti. yā ca saṅkhāranirodhasāruppagāminī paṭipadā, taṃ ca pajānāti. tathā paṭipanno ca hoti anudhammacārī.
sn12.51:8.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabbaso sammā dukkhakkhayāya paṭipanno saṅkhāranirodhāya.
sn12.51:9.1: avijjāgatoyaṃ bhikkhave, purisapuggalo puññaṃ ce saṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, puññopagaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ.
sn12.51:9.2: apuññaṃ ce saṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, apuññopagaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ.
sn12.51:9.3: āneñjaṃ ce saṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, āneñjūpagaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ.
sn12.51:9.4: yato kho bhikkhave, bhikkhuno avijjā pahīṇā hoti vijjā uppannā, so avijjāvirāgā vijjuppādā neva puññābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti. na apuññābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti. na āneñjābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti.
sn12.51:9.5: anabhisaṅkharonto anabhisañcetayanto na kiñci loke upādiyati.
sn12.51:9.6: anupādiyaṃ na paritassati. aparitassaṃ paccattaṃ yeva parinibbāyati.
sn12.51:9.7: ‘khīṇā jāti. vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ. kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ. nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāti.
sn12.51:10.1: so sukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati, sā aniccāti pajānāti. anajjhositāti pajānāti. anabhinanditāti pajānāti.
sn12.51:10.2: dukkhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati, sā aniccāti pajānāti. anajjhositāti pajānāti. anabhinanditāti pajānāti.
sn12.51:10.3: adukkhamasukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati, sā aniccāti pajānāti. anajjhositāti pajānāti. anabhinanditāti pajānāti.
sn12.51:10.4: so sukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati, visaññutto naṃ
sn12.51:10.6: vedanaṃ vediyati, visaññutto naṃ vedanaṃ vediyati. adukkhamasukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati, visaññutto naṃ vedanaṃ vediyati.
sn12.51:11.1: so kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmīti pajānāti. jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmīti pajānāti.
sn12.51:11.2: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītī bhavissanti. sarīrāni avasissantīti pajānāti.
sn12.51:12.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, puriso kumbhakārapākā uṇhaṃ kumbhaṃ uddharitvā same bhūmibhāge pativiseyya,
sn12.51:12.2: tatra yāyaṃ usmā sā tattheva vūpasameyya. kapallāni avasisseyyuṃ.
sn12.51:12.3: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno [kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti.] jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti.
sn12.51:12.4: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītī bhavissanti, sarīrāni avasissantīti pajānāti.
sn12.51:13.2: api nu kho khīṇāsavo bhikkhu puññābhisaṅkhāraṃ vā abhisaṅkhareyya, apuññābhisaṅkhāraṃ vā abhisaṅkhareyya, āneñjābhisaṅkhāraṃ vā abhisaṅkhareyyāti?
sn12.51:14.1: sabbaso vā pana saṅkhāresu asati saṅkhāranirodhā api nu kho viññāṇaṃ paññāyethāti?
sn12.51:15.1: sabbaso vā pana viññāṇe asati viññāṇanirodhā api nu kho nāmarūpaṃ paññāyethāti?
sn12.51:16.1: sabbaso vā pana nāmarūpe asati nāmarūpanirodhā api nu kho saḷāyatanaṃ paññāyethāti?
sn12.51:17.1: ‘sabbaso vā pana saḷāyatane asati saḷāyatananirodhā api nu kho phasso paññāyethāti?
sn12.51:18.1: sabbaso vā pana phasse asati phassanirodhā api nu kho vedanā paññāyethāti?
sn12.51:19.1: sabbaso vā pana vedanāya asati vedanānirodhā api nu kho taṇhā paññāyethāti?
sn12.51:20.1: sabbaso vā pana taṇhāya asati taṇhānirodhā api nu kho upādānaṃ paññāyethāti?
sn12.51:21.1: sabbaso vā pana upādāne asati upādānanirodhā api nu kho bhavo paññāyethāti?
sn12.51:22.1: sabbaso vā pana bhave asati bhavanirodhā api nu kho jāti paññāyethāti?
sn12.51:23.1: sabbaso vā pana jātiyā asati jātinirodhā api nu kho jarāmaraṇaṃ paññāyethāti?
sn12.51:24.1: sādhu sādhu kho bhikkhave, evamevetaṃ bhikkhave, netaṃ aññathā
sn12.51:24.2: saddahatha evamevetaṃ bhikkhave, adhimuccatha. nikkaṅkhā ettha hotha nibbicikicchā.
